sections.text:
JOCKEY Pump 
 A Sterling Company
 USA

This document outlines the details equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the above title block. This pump is used for fire fighting.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Haragy, 
reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, 
accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud El-Nakieb and approved by eng 
Tarek Youssef Head Sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320MW.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل؛ 
 مدير عام التفتيش وضبط الجودة EDEPC منسق MPIS ومعتمد من المحاسب محمود سليمان 
 EDEPC المدير العام للتفتيش المالي ومراقبة الجودة و 
 مشرف قطاع التفتيش وضبط الجودة.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes.... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 jockey pump.

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of 
 this pump.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 suction and delivery valves.

Remove the motor with its 
 coupling half, remove the bolts holding pedestal (S1) 
 to the bearing housing (99) and remove the pedestal.

Remove the pump half 
 coupling and key (46)
Remove bearing lock washer (69) and bearing lock nut (22)
Remove nuts and flat washers from the upper end of the bolts.

Remove the bearing housing (99) by lifting it up ball bearing (18) will be 
 removed from the shaft during this operation.
Remove deflect (40) and spacing sleeve (14 B)

Remove discharge casing (1D) with gland (17) and packing ring (13) by 
 lifting the discharge casing vertically.
Remove the shaft sleeve (14) for the packed pump

Remove last stage impeller (2) stage casing (1F). O ring ( 1H ). 
 diffuser (5) and impeller key (32)
Repeat step 11 for as many stages as are supplied until all are removed .
Lift shaft (6) with impeller hub sleeve (34) out of the suction casing (1 C)

Check the condition of the bearing surface of both the impeller hub sleeve (34) and the bearing bushing (39) located in the suction casing (1C) 
 the max. recommended diametric clearance between the OD of the two parts is 
 (0.15 mm) if the clearance is exceeded first check clearance with a new 
 impeller hub sleeve (34) it will be necessary to replace the bushing (39) one or both parts also must be replaced if the surfaces are badly scored 
 or worn to replace bushing (39) it is necessary to destroy the bushing by 
 a suitable means since it was installed with an adhesive into the suction 
 casing (1C) after the bushing removal the bore in the suction casing is 
 to be thoroughly cleaned and dried and the replacement bushing (39) is to be 
 coated on the bottom end and on its التطوير التنظيمي مع 
 لاصق.

Clean all parts check for wear and damage check for damage to impeller hub 
 surfaces if bearing (18) requires replacement drive out of the bearing 
 housing (99)

sections.text:
يجب أن تكون جميع الأجزاء الأصلية المراد إعادة استخدامها 
 تنظيفها وفحصها بدقة. يجب تنظيف الأجزاء الجديدة جيدًا.

CAUTION: 
 Surfaces where "O" rings seat must be cleaned and free of burrs. Assembly 
 starts at the suction end of the pump. The suction casing (1C) with a checked 
 and usable bushing (39) in place is placed on its base for assembly of the 
 pump vertically from upper surface.

قم بربط غلاف محور المكره (34) في الطرف السفلي 
 من العمود (6) طبقة تطبق مادة لاصقة مثل نوع Loctite 270 على 
 خيوط لتأمين الأكمام ضد الارتخاء. لاحظ أن الخيط بقي 
 يد. قم بربط جلبة محور المكره (34) لأعلى بالكامل مقابل كتف 
 رمح.

Install the first stage impeller key (32) and 
 impeller (2) on the shaft.

Insert the shaft (4) 
 with the impeller (2) and sleeve (34) just installed into the bearing 
 bushing (39) in the suction casing (1C) using a small amount of bearing 
 grease on both the outside diameter of the sleeve (34) and the wearring 
 surface of the impeller (2).
Install the first intermediate stage casing.(1F) with its O ring (1H)

Repeat the installation 
 of each 
 succeeding stage with its impeller key, impeller, intermediate stage casing 
 diffuser and "0" ring until all stages have been installed. The discharge 
 casing (ID) is next installed being sure that the shaft sleeve key (32A) has 
 first been installed in the shaft (6). Position the discharge casing with 
 its number no/./.le in the correct position with respect to the suction no/./le. 
 Install the shaft sleeve (14}or (14F) with its "O" ring (14E).

Install either the packing rings if not split or 
 the rotary for the mechanical seal followed by the gland or the mechanical 
 seal flange with stationary element.

Install spacing sleeve (14B) with its deflector 
 (40). Reinstall bearing housing, (99) with ball bearing (18).

Install tie bolts with their nuts and flat 
 washers and tighten loosely.

Install bearing lock washer (69) and bearing lock 
 nut (22). L'sing 
 the keyway in the shaft to prevent rotation. Tighten the bearing lock nut 
 (22) securely so that all parts on the shaft are tightly abutted to each 
 other. Position a tang of the lock washer (69) in one of the lock nut 
 grooves to lock the nut in position.
Install bearing cap (41) with its cap screws.

Install pedestal (81) on bearing housing (99), and re-install the motor and shaft couplings as covered by coupling 
 installation instructions.

Now tighten the tie bolts diagonally, never in 
 sequence. to the torque values shown in the fastener 
جدول قيم عزم الدوران.
